notes.title: Moviehouse Patch version 1.6.0 is now available!
notes.notes:
Dear Movie-Fans,
as promised in our recently released Content Roadmap, another big patch is live now, bringing lots of additions, including even an earlier start date: the 1960s, new research options, new improvements, and some fixes, and more! 
Find below the full changelog the Content Roadmap, to get excited, what comes next! 

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[u][b]The New Hollywood[/b][/u]
[list][*] New 1960 start date with new visuals, can be selected from the main menu (recommended after playing the 1980s start date)
[*] [u]Two new research options:[/u]
[list][*] [b]Risqueness[/b] - walk the tight rope between appealing to the new age of cinema or the old studio machine
[*] [b]Studio meddling[/b] - you're in charge! Decide how much control you will exert on the production[/list][/list]
[list][*] Added four new thematic character avatars (9 variations)
[*] Added three new thematic movie production events
[*] Added twelve new thematic plot cards[/list]

[h3]Changes and improvements[/h3]
[list][*] Improved balancing for self-distribution, turning a profit in the early game should be significantly easier when distributing good movies
[*] Reduced the profit gained from investments to improve mid to late game balance
[*] Movie traits are now displayed in the movie card[/list]


[b]Thank you for your ongoing support! Please keep it up![/b]
[b][i]-Your teams of Odyssey Studios & Assemble Entertainment-[/i][/b]

notes.title: Moviehouse Patch version 1.5.0 is now available!
notes.notes:
Dear Movie-Fans,
as promised in our recently released Content Roadmap, another big patch is live now, bringing lots of additions (like new studio boss system), a lot of improvements, and some fixes! 
Find below the full changelog the Content Roadmap, to get excited, what comes next! 

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Improved clarity when making decisions[/b]
[list][*] Redesigned movie list overview to give access to all available data about a film, including budget, plot and used set information
[*] Implemented tooltip with the previously mentioned changes during important decisions such as the film festival trivia prompt and during production to give the player all the necessary information to make their decision
[*] Updated Back Catalogue to show unreleased movies[/list]
[*] [b]New studio boss system[/b], the player can now select their character archetype when designing their studio
[list][*] The Director – the base game remains unchanged
[*] The Patron – a more difficult experience for those who want to make fine art
[*] The Exec – run a tight ship, squash any unnecessary artistic freedom in exchange for loads of cash
[*] Mogul – all costs, penalties and requirements are increased, good luck, director![/list]
[*] [b]UI improvements[/b]
[list][*] Increased small text sizes to increase visibility
[*] Adjusted UI elements to fit the new larger text sizes[/list]
[*] [b]Tutorial revamp[/b]
[list][*] Redesigned tutorial 
[*] Added explanatory images to tutorial steps
[*] Added new tutorial steps to better clarify features
[*] Rewrote existing tutorial steps for better clarity[/list]
[*] [b]Revamped the distribution system[/b]
[list][*] Swapped self distribution and studio distribution as first available distribution method
[*] Rewrote the self distribution profit calculation to better take into account the movies quality and generated buzz
[*] Implemented «Buzz Reach» to better communicate how popular the movie is and to allow the player to make the appropriate choices regarding it’s marketing
[*] [b]Implemented three new research options[/b] for self distribution to better guide the player through the process
[list][*] Poster Studio
[*] Movie Trailers
[*] Marketing Campaigns[/list][/list]
[*] [b]General performance improvements[/b]
[*] [b]Increased employee exhaustion gain rate[/b][/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list][*] Resolved issue where the player would not be able to continue the game past year 41 after the end screen
[*] Taking the money upfront distribution deal now tallies the gained income to the total profits made by the film
[*] Fixed exhaustion not being counted towards the employees total happiness in the happiness indicator
[*] Fixed the player being able to spend more then the money they have when selecting the budget for a blockbuster[/list]

[h3]Content Roadmap[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40260075/dc6cb33c537f44c7dbf704379374f3e75520398b.png[/img]


[b]Stay tuned and thank you for your ongoing support! please keep it up![/b]
[b][i]-Your teams of Odyssey Studios & Assemble Entertainment-[/i][/b]

notes.title: Moviehouse | Patch #2 | Available Now!
notes.notes:
Dear Movie-Fans,
The second Patch for Moviehouse is live now, bringing improved readability and other adjustments, as well as some fixes. This is the second patch based on the great feedback we got from lots of you! We are currently in the process of evaluating the next steps and will communicate a plan for further improvements soon.

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated UI elements to improve readability on smaller screens
[list]
[*] Text sizes should be larger across the game
[*] Increased plot card size in the card deck overview to double the card size
[*] NOTE: It's possible to adjust the UI scale in the settings, while this is an experimental feature and the UI can overlap in places on higher UI scales, it can help with accessibility. With that said, we'll be keeping an eye out on possible accessibility improvements as we go.
[/list]
[*] Slightly increased complexity requirement for productions
[*] Increased difficulty of gaining profit from low quality movies, the penalty increases depending on production size, with Blockbusters having the highest penalty
[*] Reduced research point gain, previously research point gain increased with higher movie craft & creativity, the upper scale has been adjusted to even out the point gain in the later game
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where the player was shown matching plot cards as not matching if the player had previously made a movie where the card didn't match
[*] Fixed loan repayment notification, staying even after loan has been repaid
[*] Fixed issue where media types would produce far too much profit given their customer base (Videotape, Video Discs), these distributions should now produce a slight secondary source of profit with the trade of having to use up a distribution slot as intended.
[/list]

notes.title: Moviehouse | Patch #1 | Available Now!
notes.notes:
Dear Movie-Fans,
The first Patch for Moviehouse is live now, bringing performance improvements and Balancing changes, as well as working achievements. This is the first patch based on the great feedback we got from lots of you! We are currently in the process of evaluating the next steps and will communicate a plan for further improvements soon.

[h3]Changes & Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Re-balanced the "Self Distribution" buzz requirement. This should make the self-distribution method more worthwhile, even in the early game.
[*] The "Self Distribution" research is now available earlier, and for "Indie" studios, reduced the research cost from 4 to 2 points.
[*] Changed "Any Genre" research name to "New Genre" to add clarity
[*] Increased employee exhaustion gain to make it to balance the need of maintaining your employees' happiness.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] General performance improvements
[list]
[*] Performance should be better in general, but we can't promise a massive increase for everyone, as we're still investigating the reported cases.
[*] Some users with edge cases, where the performance was show-stopping, have reported three to four times improvement.
[*] More performance improvements to follow!
[/list]
[*] Steam achievements are now rewarded accordingly!
[list]
[*] NOTE: While the achievement indicator does appear in the game, it is currently offset. This has more to do with how Steam integrates with the game, we're investigating.
[/list]
[*] Fixed the same movies being shown in film festivals every year.
[/list]

notes.title: Ready the camera! Film-making tycoon Moviehouse gets new trailer & release date
notes.notes:
Today, together with indie dev [i][b]Odyssey Studios[/b][/i] we excitingly reveal an April 5, 2023, release date for [b]Moviehouse – The Film Studio Tycoon[/b], a new film-making management tycoon that puts you in the director’s chair of an up-and-coming production studio. 
You will write, produce, and direct indies evolving into Hollywood’s biggest hits in this new spin on the classic tycoon formula.

[h3]Check out Moviehouse in the latest trailer:[/h3]
[previewyoutube=jUBDAfv_jkw;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3]About Moviehouse[/h3]
Showcased in the new [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1576280/view/3505518337785118508]devlog[/url], [b]Moviehouse – The Film Studio Tycoon[/b] proves that the devil really is in the details, with the devs showcasing how they went about creating one of the most important yet vastly overlooked pieces of movie magic: the miniature set.

Starting in the 80s where neon and practical effects ruled, and spanning through the decades to the near-real look of current day CGI, players start with a small yet passionate film crew with rudimentary equipment who have one goal: grow the studio into one of the best in the industry and keep it that way for years to come. With an eye for entertainment, pick from a dozen popular film genres and plot the perfect, award-winning storyline. Grow your operation with your razor-sharp business sense and usher in a new era for filmmakers worldwide. You only get one shot to make it or break it, and as they say: if you film it, they will come!

[h3]Features of Moviehouse – The Film Studio Tycoon[/h3]
[list][*] [u][b]That’s Showbiz, Baby!:[/b][/u] Compete in the glamorous Industry Awards showcase, vying for multiple titles including best feature film, and set your sights on winning the coveted golden clapper
[*] [u][b]The Tides of Change:[/b][/u] As the decades pass, both your team and your equipment will improve. Starting off with a small amateur cast and rudimentary equipment, the studio and all those a part of it will mature and hone their skills, while new updates in technology and filming techniques grant the ability for better filmmaking! 
[*] [u][b]Assemble the Dream Team:[/b][/u] Hire directors and writers and build up their creative skills, nurturing their creative prowess. A good crew in itself can turn casual viewers into diehard fans!
[*] [u][b]Hit the Festival Circuit: [/b][/u] Showcase your movie in film festivals to build buzz, gain accolades, and garner critical success
[*] [u][b]An Eye for Filmmaking:[/b][/u] Make a spy flick, a romantic comedy, a bloody slasher, or something entirely different. You’ve got the film-making tools at your fingertips, so it’s all up to you![/list]


[h2]Moviehouse – The Film Studio Tycoon arrives on Windows- and Mac-OS on April 5, 2023, via Steam and GOG.[/h2]

[h3]You want the latest news? [/h3]
Add [b]Moviehouse – The Film Studio Tycoon[/b] here on Steam to your Wishlist to receive latest news, updates, and get notified as soon as the game will release April 5, 2023!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1576280/Moviehouse__The_Film_Studio_Tycoon/
